text:
maria.eng: Customer kickoff: EU primary + 2 small POPs. 6-12mo ramp. Goals: p95 <=250ms, 1,200 concurrent peak, 120k DAU, ~200 tokens/session. Need hardware, racks, network, and cost bands including seasonal peak (assume up to 1.6x in Q4).

lee.infra: Back-of-envelope forecast w/ seasonal factor.
```
DAU = 120000
avg_tokens/session = 200
daily_tokens = 24,000,000
base_tps = daily_tokens / 86400 ≈ 278 t/s
peak_concurrency = 1200
avg_session_secs = 20
peak_tps_nominal = 1200 * (200/20) = 12,000 t/s
seasonal_multiplier = 1.6 -> peak_tps_seasonal = 19,200 t/s
tokens_per_gpu_sec (H100 quantized 30B) = 450 t/s
raw_gpus_needed_seasonal = ceil(19200 / 450) = 43 GPUs
GPU_hours/day ≈ 43 * 24 * duty_factor(0.6) ≈ 619 GPU-hours/day
GPU_hours/month ≈ 18,570 GPU-hours/month
```
These are conservative; prefix caching could shave 20-40% off peak.

sam.platform: Confirming models/traffic mix? That will affect tokens_per_gpu_sec and caching benefit.

maria.eng: They'll run a quantized 30B chat model + 7B reranker. Chat is ~85% of traffic. No on-site tuning.

olivia.sre: For p95<=250ms we need tail headroom. Recommend adding 20% to raw GPUs for queuing/jitter -> target ~52 GPUs for seasonal peak. Also keep a warm pool of 1-2 nodes and 1 hot-standby node.

lee.infra: Mapping to hardware:
- Primary: 7 x 8-GPU H100 nodes = 56 GPUs (gives spare capacity, supports failover)
- Distribute across 2 racks: Rack A 4 nodes, Rack B 3 nodes
- Edge POPs (2): each 2 x 4-GPU servers (A10/L4) = 8 GPUs per POP
Total cluster GPUs = 56 + 8 + 8 = 72 GPUs (mixed SKUs)

lee.infra: Power per 8x H100 node ~7kW peak. Plan 8-9kW breaker per node. Rack (4 nodes) ~28kW -> consider chilled-water or liquid cooling if customer has <30kW/rack limit.

sam.platform: Network:
- Primary fabric: 100Gbps with RDMA, low-latency leaf-spine
- POP uplinks: 25-40Gbps acceptable depending on traffic share
- Control plane: persistent 1Gbps to Redwood with mutual TLS

olivia.sre: Ops/security checklist (short):
- VPC peering/PrivateLink, mTLS to control plane
- KMS/HSM placement & network reachability
- NTP/DNS internal availability
- Per-GPU telemetry, per-session tracing, token-level cost logs
- Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with metric gates (p95, errors, throughput)

sam.platform: Quick SE snippet (run with customer inputs):
```
{ "dau":120000, "avg_tokens":200, "avg_session_secs":20, "peak_concurrency":1200, "seasonal_mult":1.6, "tokens_per_gpu_sec":450, "tail_headroom":1.2 }
# GPUs = ceil((((peak_concurrency * (avg_tokens/avg_session_secs)) * seasonal_mult) / tokens_per_gpu_sec) * tail_headroom)
```

aaron.sales: Cost bands (rough, region-dependent):
- CAPEX primary (7x8-GPU H100 + switches/rack/install): $1.2M – $2.0M
- POPs (2 small POPs): $90k – $220k
- OPEX (power, support, spare parts): $10k – $25k/month
Note: cite assumptions (GPU SKU, regional taxes, installation complexity). Provide a discrete option with A10/L4 SKUs to reduce CAPEX but increase GPU count.

maria.eng: Action items: Lee finalizes rack/power table; Sam posts sanitized snippet & perf-harness command; Olivia completes SRE checklist; Aaron drafts customer-facing cost appendix and contract acceptance tests. Target: deliver consolidated playbook next Tue.

deploy-bot: upload: drive.company/sizing/eu-edge-playbook-v1 (permissions: redwood/eng-platform, redwood/solutions)

maria.eng: Thanks team. Keeping thread compact for SEs. We'll spin a full doc with runbooks and acceptance test steps.
